Vanessa / team / Alicia — I dug into the serving logs and billing pipeline. Summary:

What happened (short):
- On 2026-11-28 22:14 UTC a transient routing restart during a rolling deploy triggered a rare duplication path in our prefix handling layer for a small percentage of live requests. That caused both the request and a replay of its output to be emitted to the billing pipeline for ~3 hours (22:14–01:12 UTC).
- The duplication affected ~0.8% of total requests across the affected pool but, due to a concentrated high-throughput job at Nodalytics, it manifested as an apparent ~1.9x token count for your account during the window.

Actions taken:
- The runtime fix (2026-11-28 23:01 UTC) prevented further duplication; we removed duplicate records from the billing ingestion at 2026-11-29 02:04 UTC.
- I produced a filtered token export for the Nodalytics account for Nov 28–29 and attached it. The raw delta and the filtered baseline are in the spreadsheet Laura will attach.

Next: Laura / Marissa — based on the filtered export the provisional overcount is 48,390 tokens (approx $172 at your current pricing). I recommend we offer a customer credit for the full overcount and provide a transparent summary of the engineering root cause.

Apologies for the incident — we’re running a short postmortem and will share the summary.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Staff, Serving Reliability

[Attachment: redwood-nodalytics-token-delta.csv (CSV, 28KB)]
